messages:
Avery: Quick sync — we need a short, customer-friendly follow-up for the 2024-04-22 outage. Goals: agree statuspage language, 72h customer summary, and the default policy for RCA sharing. Also assign owners + timelines.

Sam: I can jump on now. Where's the draft?

Avery: Draft is here: https://docs.redwood.example/ops/incidents/2024-04-22-outage-draft. Main asks:
- 72h customer summary (public/enterprise variants)
- 1-2 line statuspage visible blurb
- RCA sharing policy sentence for public page + instructions for customers wanting a full RCA

Priya: I'll take the 72h summary. Can I get EOD tomorrow to produce a working draft? I can handle legal redactions with legal looped in.

Ken: I can own the statuspage copy. Draft below — pls react with edits.

```
Status: Partial service disruption — Resolved
Impact: Some customers experienced increased latency and failed requests to the embedding endpoint between 03:12–03:42 UTC.
Next steps: We mitigated the immediate cause and are performing a detailed investigation. A summary will be posted within 72 hours.
```

Gina: :eyes: Suggest we soften “root cause” language to “investigation identified”. Also CS: customers may ask for logs — what's our standard ask/offer for impacted customers?

Avery: Good call. For RCA sharing: default = high-level summary on status page. Full RCA available to impacted customers upon request; requires consent/NDA depending on sensitivity. We'll add a link to the support request flow. Ken — can you add a sentence about how to request the detailed RCA?

Sam: Also flagging that this incident looks related to the recurring KV cache eviction spikes we've observed every quarter. Need an SRE owner for the recurrence pattern follow-up (add to action tracker).

incident-bot: Action INC-4567 created and assigned to Omar. Link: https://tracker.redwood.example/INC-4567

Ken: Updated statuspage copy and added: "Impacted customers may request a detailed RCA via our support portal; we'll publish a redacted public RCA when appropriate." Pushed to staging; deploy scheduled 10:30 PT.

Priya: 72h summary ETA: 2024-04-26 17:00 PT. I'll coordinate with Legal and Gina for customer-facing wording.

Gina: I'll draft targeted outreach for enterprise accounts and share by 2024-04-27 EOD for review.

Omar: On the recurring cache eviction pattern — I'm on it. I'll open a follow-up ticket with mitigations and ETAs. ETA for mitigation proposal: 2024-05-06.

Sam: Assign SRE action: update monitoring to alert on pre-eviction memory patterns, owner Omar, due 2024-05-06.

Avery: I'll draft the RCA-sharing policy blurb and send to Legal for approval by 2024-04-28. Quick check-in scheduled Friday 11:00 PT to confirm copy and published artifacts. :calendar:

incident-bot: Follow-up check scheduled for 1719060000 (Fri).
